existing_measures.name: Sessions
existing_measures.description: Count of sessions from gold_ga4_sessions (one row per session). Do not SUM the pre-aggregated sessions columns on Daily KPIs or Landing Pages.

existing_measures.name: Users
existing_measures.description: Distinct user_pseudo_id from gold_ga4_sessions. Users do not add up across channel, device, or page breakdowns.

existing_measures.name: New Users
existing_measures.description: Distinct users whose first session (is_new_user) is in the current filter context.

existing_measures.name: Engaged Sessions
existing_measures.description: Sessions flagged engaged (GA4 session_engaged = 1) in gold_ga4_sessions.

existing_measures.name: Engagement Rate
existing_measures.description: Engaged Sessions divided by Sessions. This is the GA4 engagement rate, not 1 minus Universal Analytics bounce rate. Computed with DIVIDE; do not average the engagement_rate column.

existing_measures.name: Purchases
existing_measures.description: Count of purchase events in gold_ga4_sessions (SUM of purchases). A session can have more than one purchase.

existing_measures.name: Revenue
existing_measures.description: Sum of purchase revenue in USD from gold_ga4_sessions.

existing_measures.name: Conversion Rate
existing_measures.description: Share of sessions with at least one purchase. Computed with DIVIDE; do not average the conversion_rate column.

existing_measures.name: AOV
existing_measures.description: Average order value: Revenue divided by Purchases (purchase events). Computed with DIVIDE; do not average the aov column.

existing_measures.name: Revenue per Session
existing_measures.description: Revenue divided by Sessions. Computed with DIVIDE; do not average the revenue_per_session column.

existing_measures.name: Revenue Share of Top Channel
existing_measures.description: Share of Revenue that comes from the single largest channel_group in the current selection (ALLSELECTED on Channel). A concentration-risk KPI.
existing_measures.expr:
VAR TotalRevenue =
    CALCULATE([Revenue], ALLSELECTED('Channel'[channel_group]))
VAR TopChannelRevenue =
    MAXX(
        ALLSELECTED('Channel'[channel_group]),
        [Revenue]
    )
RETURN
DIVIDE(TopChannelRevenue, TotalRevenue)

existing_measures.name: Pageviews
existing_measures.description: Sum of pageviews from gold_ga4_page_sessions (page_view events with a page_location).

existing_measures.name: View Item Sessions
existing_measures.description: Sessions that fired view_item, summed from gold_ga4_funnel_daily (additive at date × channel × device).

existing_measures.name: Add to Cart Sessions
existing_measures.description: Sessions that fired add_to_cart, summed from gold_ga4_funnel_daily.

existing_measures.name: Begin Checkout Sessions
existing_measures.description: Sessions that fired begin_checkout, summed from gold_ga4_funnel_daily.

existing_measures.name: Add Payment Info Sessions
existing_measures.description: Sessions that fired add_payment_info, summed from gold_ga4_funnel_daily.

existing_measures.name: Purchase Sessions
existing_measures.description: Sessions that fired purchase, summed from gold_ga4_funnel_daily. Distinct from Purchases, which counts purchase events.

existing_measures.name: View Item to Cart Rate
existing_measures.description: Add to Cart Sessions divided by View Item Sessions.
existing_measures.expr: DIVIDE([Add to Cart Sessions], [View Item Sessions])

existing_measures.name: Cart to Checkout Rate
existing_measures.description: Begin Checkout Sessions divided by Add to Cart Sessions.
existing_measures.expr: DIVIDE([Begin Checkout Sessions], [Add to Cart Sessions])

existing_measures.name: Checkout to Payment Rate
existing_measures.description: Add Payment Info Sessions divided by Begin Checkout Sessions.
existing_measures.expr: DIVIDE([Add Payment Info Sessions], [Begin Checkout Sessions])

existing_measures.name: Payment to Purchase Rate
existing_measures.description: Purchase Sessions divided by Add Payment Info Sessions.

existing_measures.name: View Item to Purchase Rate
existing_measures.description: Purchase Sessions divided by View Item Sessions (overall funnel conversion).

existing_measures.name: Item Views
existing_measures.description: Item-level view_item counts from gold_ga4_items_daily (related-item noise already removed in gold).

existing_measures.name: Add to Carts
existing_measures.description: Item-level add_to_cart counts from gold_ga4_items_daily.

existing_measures.name: Item Revenue
existing_measures.description: Item-level purchase revenue from gold_ga4_items_daily. May differ slightly from Revenue, which is session purchase_revenue_in_usd.

existing_measures.name: Add-to-Cart Rate
existing_measures.description: Add to Carts divided by Item Views. Computed with DIVIDE.

additional_measures_required.name: Revenue MoM %
additional_measures_required.expression: DIVIDE([Revenue] - [Previous Calendar Month Revenue], [Previous Calendar Month Revenue])

additional_measures_required.name: Checkout to Purchase Ratio
additional_measures_required.warning: Independent event count ratio; not ordered conversion.

additional_series_required: Device event reach percentages = each event session measure / [Sessions], evaluated per Device.
production_cautions: Additional month-over-month comparisons for Sessions, Conversion Rate, Purchases and Revenue per Session still need implementation.
Guard comparisons to exactly one complete calendar month; November and full-window return BLANK.
Category uses the verified Items Daily[item_category] field from the gold schema.
HTML country fixture is illustrative; native use Sessions[country].
Product conversion is not a modeled measure; show item views, add-to-cart rate and item revenue.
